rederive: Full fresh log, exact normal status/plan, contiguous literal outer cases, unchanged declared input hashes and baseline test bytes.
falsify: Reject noninteger or nonzero status, missing/duplicated outer case, skip/not-ok/absent normal summary, changed input identity and observed surviving known PID. Literal provider tests separately discriminate discovery, dependency, CWD/resource and shared-root regressions.
durability: Complete compressed fresh log/recipe/normal OS report, tracked outcome and input proof, task/book/Knowledge Map and normal staged/commit gates.
limits: Focused changed-source capacity verification only. No complete full-CI, full3 allocation-cause repair, historical native-startup repair or hosted/push success. Raw OS resource fields retain their literal scopes without cross-field conversion or performance claims.
